'''Zoho Corporation''' is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[technology company]] that makes [[cloud computing|cloud]]-based [[business software]].<ref name=":6">{{cite news |last1=Sharma |first1=Disha |title=How SaaS poster boys Zoho and Freshworks ended up in a drag-out fight over alleged theft of ideas |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/prime/technology-and-startups/how-saas-poster-boys-zoho-and-freshworks-ended-up-in-a-drag-out-fight-over-alleged-theft-of-ideas/primearticleshow/81617747.cms |access-date=10 May 2021 |work=The Economic Times}}</ref> Its core products include workplace [[Productivity software|productivity]] and [[collaboration software]], [[customer relationship management]] (CRM) software, and [[business management tools]].<ref name="Mint3"/> The company was founded in 1996 by [[Sridhar Vembu]] and Tony Thomas as AdventNet, Inc., in New Jersey.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bagchi |first=Shrabonti |date=2021-07-29 |title=Sridhar Vembu's village lab |url=https://lifestyle.livemint.com//news/big-story/sridhar-vembu-s-village-lab-111627555674138.html |access-date=2021-11-30 |website=Mintlounge |language=en}}</ref> Zoho is headquartered in [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]], India, and has offices in 80 countries, with its US headquarters located in [[Austin, Texas]].<ref name="dcn">{{Cite web |date=2025-09-30 |title='We don't use AWS or Azure': Sridhar Vembu clears air on Arattai, Zoho's desi tech backbone |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/we-dont-use-aws-or-azure-sridhar-vembu-clears-air-on-arattai-zohos-desi-tech-backbone-496250-2025-09-30 |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=Business Today |language=en}}</ref>

As of 2023, it is privately owned,<ref>{{Cite news |last=Prinsloo |first=Loni |last2=Rantijes |first2=Rivaldo |date=25 Feb 2026 |title=Billionaire-backed Zoho plans more Mid-East, Africa data centers |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-25/billionaire-backed-zoho-plans-more-mideast-africa-data-centers |access-date=25 February 2026 |work=[[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]]}}</ref> with co-founders Tony Thomas and Sridhar Vembu holding  8% and 5% stakes, and Sridhar Vembu's sister [[Radha Vembu]] and brother Sekar Vembu owning 47.8% and 35.2% of the company, respectively.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kroll |first1=Luisa |last2=A. Dolan |first2=Kerry |title=In High Stakes Divorce Battle, Estranged Wife Of Indian Software Tycoon Claims He Transferred Ownership Without Telling Her |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/luisakroll/2023/03/13/zoho-srindhar-vembu-in-high-stakes-divorce-battle-estranged-wife-of-indian-software-tycoon-claims-he-transferred-ownership-without-telling-her/ |access-date=8 July 2025 |work=Forbes |date=13 March 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Kashyap |first1=Hemant |title=Sridhar Vembu, Pramila Srinivasan & The Zoho Shareholding Saga |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/sridhar-vembu-pramila-srinivasan-zoho-shareholding-divorce/ |access-date=8 July 2025 |work=Inc42 Media |date=15 March 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

==History==
From 1996 to 2009, the company was known as AdventNet, Inc., founded in [[New Jersey]], US, and initially provided a [[network management software]] called WebNMS.<ref name="Arakali2016-06-06"/><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Mukherjee |first=Sharmistha |date=2017-02-02 |title=How to build a global company from a small town: The Zoho story |url=https://techseen.com/2017/02/02/global-company-zoho-story/ |access-date=2022-05-17 |website=TECHSEEN |language=en-US}}</ref>

AdventNet expanded operations into [[Japan]] in 2001 and shifted focus to [[small and medium businesses]] (SMBs).<ref name=":3" /> In 2002, the company started its [[enterprise IT management]] software division known as ManageEngine.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ghosh |first1=Debangana |title=Zoho Corp's arm ManageEngine eyes $1 billion in revenue in 2-3 years |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zoho-corps-arm-manageengine-to-achieve-1-billion-in-revenue-in-2-3-years-9973691.html |access-date=8 October 2025 |work=Moneycontrol |date=31 January 2023}}</ref>

[[Zoho CRM (application)|Zoho CRM]] was released in 2005, along with Zoho Writer, the company's first [[office suite]] product.<ref name=":3" /> Zoho Projects, Creator, Sheet, and Show were released in 2006.<ref name=":3" /> It expanded into the [[collaboration software|collaboration space]] with the release of Zoho Docs and Zoho Meeting in 2007. In 2008, the company added invoicing and mail applications.<ref name="adventnet">{{cite web |title=How Sridhar Vembu's Zoho Corporation changed avatars since its inception in 1996 as AdventNet |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=2011-11-11 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/india-emerging/how-sridhar-vembus-zoho-corporation-changed-avatars-since-its-inception-in-1996-as-adventnet/articleshow/10686644.cms |access-date=2020-12-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190821143426/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/india-emerging/how-sridhar-vembus-zoho-corporation-changed-avatars-since-its-inception-in-1996-as-adventnet/articleshow/10686644.cms |archive-date=2019-08-21}}</ref> In 2009, the company was renamed Zoho Corporation after [[Zoho Office Suite|its online office suite]].<ref name="Arakali2016-06-06">{{cite news|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/boardroom/the-bootstrapped-buddhist-how-sridhar-vembu-built-zoho/43383/1|title=The Bootstrapped Buddhist: How Sridhar Vembu built Zoho|last=Arakali|first=Harichandan|date=6 June 2016|newspaper=[[Forbes India]]|access-date=21 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161021130923/http://www.forbesindia.com/article/boardroom/the-bootstrapped-buddhist-how-sridhar-vembu-built-zoho/43383/1|url-status=live|archive-date=21 October 2016}}</ref> The company remains privately owned.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/the-maverick-who-shuns-investors/article8573158.ece|title=The maverick who shuns investors|last=Kumar|first=K. Bharat|date=2016-05-08|work=The Hindu|access-date=2019-07-22|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X|archive-date=15 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200915184031/https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/the-maverick-who-shuns-investors/article8573158.ece|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2014, Zoho had its first annual user conference, called Zoholics, in India.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |date=2022-11-08 |title=Now a $1 billion firm, Zoho announces new R&D investments |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/technology/tech-news-technology/now-a-1-billion-firm-zoho-announces-new-rd-investments-8256376/ |access-date=2022-12-01 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Mint3" /> In 2017, Zoho launched Zoho One, a platform of over 40 integrated applications.<ref name="AboutZoho">{{cite web | title=About Zoho - Our Story, List of Products | website=Zoho Corporation | url=https://www.zoho.com/aboutus.html | access-date=28 December 2018 | archive-date=21 December 2018 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181221054205/https://www.zoho.com/aboutus.html | url-status=live }}</ref> In 2020, it launched Zoho Workplace, a suite combining its existing [[Productivity software|productivity]], [[collaboration software|collaboration]], and [[communication software]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Zoho takes on Microsoft, Google with unified Workplace platform |url=https://cio.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/corporate-news/zoho-takes-on-microsoft-google-with-unified-workplace-platform/78075284 |access-date=8 October 2025 |work=ETCIO.com |publisher=The Economic Times |date=12 September 2020 |language=en}}</ref>

In 2023, [[Enterprise resource planning|ERP]] software company Gofrugal, founded by Sridhar Vembu's brother Kumar Vembu, merged with Zoho.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gofrugal + Zoho Merger Announcement |url=https://www.gofrugal.com/announcements/CEO-letter-announcement.html |publisher=Gofrugal |access-date=8 October 2025}}</ref> In 2025, Zoho announced the launch of its [[large language model]], Zia, for enterprise [[Artificial intelligence|AI]] applications.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Bhati |first1=Divya |title=Zoho launches Zia LLM, says it will help Indian companies join AI race |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/news/story/zoho-launches-zia-llm-says-it-will-help-indian-companies-join-ai-race-2757133-2025-07-17 |access-date=8 October 2025 |work=India Today |date=17 July 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

Following a [[Government procurement|government tender]] won by Zoho in September 2023, all 1.2 million email accounts of Indian central government employees were [[Email migration|migrated]] from the [[National Informatics Centre|NIC]]-based system to Zoho Mail by 2025, while office productivity tools were shifted to the Zoho Workplace suite.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chauhan |first1=Neeraj |title=Govt selects Chennai-based IT firm as 1st pvt contractor for email utilities |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/govt-selects-chennai-based-it-firm-as-first-pvt-contractor-for-email-desktop-utilities-101694457926568.html |access-date=6 April 2026 |work=Hindustan Times |date=12 September 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite news |last1=Singh |first1=Vijaita |last2=Deep |first2=Aroon |title=Email accounts of 12 lakh Central government employees now run on Zoho's platform |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/email-accounts-of-12-lakh-central-government-employees-now-run-on-zohos-platform/article70155315.ece |access-date=26 October 2025 |work=The Hindu |date=12 October 2025 |language=en-IN}}</ref>

In January 2025, co-founder Shailesh Kumar Davey succeeded Sridhar Vembu as group CEO, while Vembu transitioned to the role of chief scientist to focus on research and development.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/sridhar-vembu-steps-down-as-zoho-ceo-shailesh-kumar-davey-to-succeed-125012701252_1.html|title=Sridhar Vembu steps down as Zoho CEO; Shailesh Kumar Davey to succeed|work=Business Standard|date=27 January 2025|access-date=20 March 2026}}</ref> In January 2026, Zoho launched Zoho ERP, an [[enterprise resource planning]] product developed at its Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu office.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://thefederal.com/category/business/zoho-launches-made-in-india-erp-solution-from-kumbakonam-226620|title=Zoho launches made-in-India ERP solution from Kumbakonam|work=The Federal|date=January 2026|access-date=20 March 2026}}</ref> The same month, the company opened its first data centers in the [[United Arab Emirates]], in [[Dubai]] and [[Abu Dhabi]].{{citation needed|date=April 2026}}

In 2026 Zoho Unveils [[Nathu La]], a Designed-in-House Server, server motherboard and chassis platform in a Move Towards Technological Sovereignty and Inference Cost Reduction<ref>{{cite web |title=Zoho-Corporation-Unveils-Nathu-La-a-Designed-in-House-Server |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260609950105/en/Zoho-Corporation-Unveils-Nathu-La-a-Designed-in-House-Server-in-a-Move-Towards-Technological-Sovereignty-and-Inference-Cost-Reduction |access-date=2026-06-10}}</ref>.

== Digital sovereignty ==
Zoho presents their "home-grown" business as supporting Indian [[Technological sovereignty|digital sovereignty]],<ref>{{Cite news |last=Latin Trade Staff |date=2025-12-21 |title=Is your nation really sovereign? Do you know where your country's digital borders are?An interview with ZohoCorp |url=https://latintrade.com/2025/12/21/is-your-nation-really-sovereign-do-you-know-where-your-countrys-digital-borders-arean-interview-with-zohocorp/ |work=Latin Trade}}</ref> both through the government's use of Zoho Mail and Zoho Workplace and through their messaging app [[Arattai]], which is presented as "India's [[WhatsApp]]".<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-10-03 |title=Zoho bets on data sovereignty, ad-free model to scale as ministers rally behind local tech |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/zoho-bets-on-data-sovereignty-ad-free-model-to-scale-as-ministers-rally-behind-local-tech/articleshow/124278140.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-02-25 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> In April 2026, the company also promoted a new data center in the UK as improving British digital sovereignty.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Jackson |first=Amber |date=2026-04-08 |title=Zoho unveils UK data centre in digital sovereignty bid |url=https://capacityglobal.com/news/zoho-uk-announce-data-centre-amid-country-growth/ |access-date=2026-04-10 |website=Capacity |language=en-US}}</ref>

There has been some controversy over whether Zoho genuinely offers digital sovereignty and concerns that it is a private company and it has had multiple security issues.<ref name=":9">{{Cite web |last=Moglen |first=Mishi Choudhary,Eben |date=2025-10-28 |title=Zoho Had a Chance to Change India's Tech Future. It Didn't |url=https://www.thequint.com/opinion/zoho-deal-digital-india-security-concerns-what-went-wrong |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=TheQuint |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":7">{{Cite news |last=Sidhu |first=K.B.S. |date=2025-10-08 |title=Zoho is no Signal. India must not put Swadeshi before security |url=https://theprint.in/opinion/zoho-signal-india-swadeshi-security/2759574/ |work=The Print}}</ref> Rather than being "a simple tech upgrade," an opinion writer in ''The Wire'' wrote, the migration of over 1.2 million government emails from the [[National Informatics Centre]] to Zoho was "a fundamental policy decision that surrenders a core sovereign function to a commercial entity".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kumar |first=Arun |date=2025-10-25 |title=Digital Sovereignty or Surrender? Modi Govt's Zoho Shift is a Troubling Step Backwards |url=https://thewire.in/tech/digital-sovereignty-or-surrender-modi-govts-zoho-shift-is-a-troubling-step-backwards |access-date=2026-04-10 |website=[[The Wire (India)|The Wire]] |language=en}}</ref> ''[[The Hindu]]'' wrote that a "senior official says Zoho’s suite has been activated to ensure that government employees do not use [[Open-source software|open-source applications]]."<ref name=":4" />

==Products==
Zoho has over 45 integrated applications, mainly designed for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), but scalable for larger enterprises. These products span many categories, including customer relationship management, marketing, sales, customer support, finance, human resources, collaboration, productivity, operations, IT management, and analytics. Notable products include the [[online office suite]] offering [[Zoho Office Suite]], [[customer relationship management]] software [[Zoho CRM (application)|Zoho CRM]], [[accounting software]] Zoho Books, [[Human resource management system|HR management platform]] Zoho People, and [[project management software]] Zoho Projects.<ref name=":5" /><ref>{{cite web |last1=Mukherjee |first1=Ayush |title=Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw picks Zoho over Google and Microsoft, here's why |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/technology/union-minister-ashwini-vaishnaw-picks-zoho-over-google-and-microsoft-here-s-why-article-13569653.html |website=Moneycontrol |access-date=8 October 2025 |date=23 September 2025}}</ref>

ManageEngine has both [[On-premises software|on-premises]] and [[Software as a service|cloud-based]] software products in categories such as [[enterprise IT management]], [[cybersecurity]], and [[unified endpoint management]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Ashutosh |title=Inside ManageEngine's AI-powered growth strategy towards $1 bn in revenue |url=https://www.business-standard.com/technology/tech-news/inside-manageengine-s-ai-powered-growth-strategy-towards-1-bn-in-revenue-124091100850_1.html |access-date=8 October 2025 |work=Business Standard |date=11 September 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Goled |first1=Shraddha |title=Zoho's ManageEngine may become $1 bn firm ahead of target, says senior exec |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2024/02/29/zoho-s-manageengine-may-become-1-bn-firm-ahead-of-target-says-senior-exec |access-date=12 October 2025 |work=Techcircle |date=29 February 2024 |language=en}}</ref>

=== Messaging app ===

[[Arattai]] is an [[instant messaging application]] developed by Zoho and launched in January 2021.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2021-01-10 |title=Homegrown tech firm Zoho develops messaging app Arattai |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/homegrown-tech-firm-zoho-develops-messaging-app-arattai/articleshow/80200200.cms |access-date=2025-10-03 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> It experienced a brief surge in new user sign-ups in 2025 when Zoho products were promoted by [[Government of India|Indian government]] officials as part of their push for homegrown alternatives to foreign‐owned apps.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kumar |first=Rakesh |date=2025-10-02 |title=Zoho-led messaging app Arattai becomes the talks of the town |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/xplore/2025/Oct/02/zoho-led-messaging-app-arattai-becomes-the-talks-of-the-town |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Mittal |first1=Apoorva |title=Will Arattai be India's answer to WhatsApp? |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/will-arattai-be-indias-answer-to-whatsapp/articleshow/124311928.cms |access-date=8 October 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=5 October 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-08 |title=Arattai: The Indian messaging app that wants to take on WhatsApp |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy50299w5vwo |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=www.bbc.com |language=en-GB}}</ref> Zoho also launched its Arattai Business app which is a dedicated app that helps small and medium businesses build their presence on Arattai and manage customer conversations, on the same network your customers already use to chat.<ref>{{Cite web |title=About Arattai Business |url=https://help.arattai.in/portal/en/kb/articles/about-arattai-business |url-status=live |website=arattai help}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Jha |first=Mayank |date=August 15, 2026 |title=Zoho Arattai Business Takes on WhatsApp Business: What To Expect |url=https://www.news18.com/tech/zoho-arattai-business-takes-on-whatsapp-business-what-to-expect-ws-l-10275539.html |url-status=live |work=news18 |pages=1}}</ref>

=== Browser ===
Ulaa Browser is a [[web browser]] developed by Zoho, based on the [[Chromium (web browser)|Chromium]] open-source project and released in 2023. Ulaa routes its [[Domain Name System]] (DNS) queries through India's national [[Root name server|root server]] system, rather than using default global DNS providers.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Venugopal |first=Sahana |date=2025-05-05 |title=Zoho Ulaa Review {{!}} A no-frills privacy browser for Google Chrome users |url=https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/zoho-ulaa-review-a-no-frills-privacy-browser-for-google-chrome-users/article69540009.ece |access-date=2025-10-03 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}</ref>

=== Email ===
Zoho Mail is an [[email]] service developed by Zoho Corporation in 2008 for individuals and organizations. The email hosting service supports [[Domain name|custom domain]] addresses and is integrated with other Zoho products within the Zoho Workplace suite.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gusain |first=Unnati |date=2025-10-09 |title=Amit Shah switches to Zoho Mail, Sridhar Vembu says 20-year faith of Indian engineers vindicated |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/news/story/amit-shah-switches-to-zoho-mail-sridhar-vembu-says-20-year-faith-of-indian-engineers-vindicated-2800205-2025-10-09 |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=India Today |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-10-08 |title=Amit Shah switches to Zoho Mail |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/amit-shah-switches-to-zoho-mail/article70140844.ece |access-date=2025-10-10 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}</ref>

=== Payment app ===
[[File:Davis 20180806 152844.jpg|thumb|Zoho One train wrap on the [[Chicago Transit Authority|CTA]]'s [[5000-series (CTA)|5000-series]] railcar in Chicago]]
Zoho Pay, a [[Unified Payments Interface|UPI]]-based payments and money transfer application integrated with its messaging platform Arattai and available as a standalone mobile app in India. Zoho pay is currently in testing and expected to release soon.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tech |first=India Today |date=2025-10-23 |title=Zoho UPI app launch: What you need to know about Zoho Pay |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/news/story/zoho-pay-upi-app-launch-details-2807297-2025-10-23 |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=India Today |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-22 |title=After Arattai, Zoho Pay UPI app to compete with PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay: Here's what you need to know |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/life/technology-after-arattai-zoho-pay-upi-app-to-compete-with-phonepe-paytm-google-pay-heres-what-you-need-to-know-4018416/ |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=FE Tech Bytes |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-24 |title=Indian man who's challenging WhatsApp, now takes up new UPI project to fight Paytm, PhonePe… |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/indian-man-who-s-challenging-whatsapp-now-takes-up-new-upi-project-to-fight-paytm-phonepe-101761279502404.html |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=Hindustan Times |language=en}}</ref>

== Security issues ==
Zoho has been criticized for multiple security issues.<ref name=":9" /><ref name=":7" /> In 2021, hackers exploited vulnerabilities in a [[Password manager|password management]] and [[single sign-on]] system provided by Zoho's ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Glover |first=Claudia |date=2021-11-08 |title=Zoho hack: Here's what businesses need to know about the major breach |url=https://www.techmonitor.ai/technology/cybersecurity/zoho-hack-emmisary-panda-apt-china |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=Tech Monitor |language=en-US}}</ref> In January 2022, the vulnerability was used to target the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]] (ICRC), and data of 515,000 people was [[Data breach|compromised]], with the ICRC admitting that it did not apply a [[security patch]] released by Zoho in September 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bagwe |first=Mihir |date=2022-02-16 |title=Unpatched Zoho Bug Exploited in Red Cross Attack |url=https://www.bankinfosecurity.com/unpatched-zoho-bug-exploited-in-red-cross-attack-a-18523 |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=www.bankinfosecurity.com |language=en}}</ref>

In 2025, an [[SQL injection]] vulnerability allowed attackers to run unauthenticated SQL queries, potentially giving access to sensitive information in databases hosted by Zoho.<ref>{{Cite web |last=AnuPriya |date=2025-11-14 |title=Critical Zoho Analytics Plus Flaw Allows Attackers to Run Arbitrary SQL Queries |url=https://cyberpress.org/zoho-analytics-plus-flaw/ |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=Cyber Security News |language=en-US}}</ref> The same year, Zoho's messaging app, [[Arattai]], was criticized for lacking [[end-to-end encryption]] for chats.<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |title=Security blind spot: Zoho Arattai's missing end-to-end encryption for chats |url=https://www.storyboard18.com/digital/security-blind-spot-zoho-arattais-missing-end-to-end-encryption-for-chats-81995.htm |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=www.storyboard18.com |language=en}}</ref>

In February 2026, a North Korean group released tools that use a backdoor to Zoho WorkDrive to deploy malware.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lakshmanan |first=Ravie |date=2026-02-27 |title=ScarCruft Uses Zoho WorkDrive and USB Malware to Breach Air-Gapped Networks |url=http://thehackernews.com/2026/02/scarcruft-uses-zoho-workdrive-and-usb.html |access-date=2026-04-10 |website=[[Hacker News]] |language=en}}</ref>

==Locations==
Zoho is headquartered in Chennai, India. As of 2025, it has offices in over 80 countries,<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Hartmans |first=Avery |title=Employees at global software firm Zoho have turned the company's Austin headquarters into a fully functioning farm. It's become a respite during the pandemic, and could serve as a model for a new way of working. |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/zoho-austin-headquarters-farm-coronavirus-pandemic-2020-11 |access-date=2022-01-11 |website=Business Insider |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/cloud-services-firm-zoho-to-shift-us-headquarters/article28446740.ece|title=Cloud services firm Zoho to shift U.S. headquarters|date=2019-07-15|work=The Hindu|access-date=2019-07-22|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X|archive-date=7 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201107235756/https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/cloud-services-firm-zoho-to-shift-us-headquarters/article28446740.ece|url-status=live}}</ref> including [[China]], [[Singapore]], and [[Japan]]. The bulk of its operations is carried out from its office in Chennai.<ref name="Mint3">{{cite news|url= http://www.livemint.com/Industry/nUrZ1nF71fR0O95YXzzn3J/Is-Zoho-future-of-enterprise-software.html|title= Is Zoho the future of enterprise software?|last1= D'Monte|first1= Leslie|date= 24 November 2014|newspaper= [[Livemint]]|publisher= HT Media Ltd.|access-date= 5 August 2015|archive-date= 13 August 2015|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20150813160300/http://www.livemint.com/Industry/nUrZ1nF71fR0O95YXzzn3J/Is-Zoho-future-of-enterprise-software.html|url-status= live}}</ref><ref name="FE">{{cite news|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/article/industry/companies/zoho-eyes-100-million-users-of-its-products-in-five-years/113861/|title=Zoho Corporation eyes 100 million users of its products in five years|date=8 August 2015|newspaper=Financial Express|access-date=5 August 2015|archive-date=8 August 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150808024218/http://www.financialexpress.com/article/industry/companies/zoho-eyes-100-million-users-of-its-products-in-five-years/113861/|url-status=live}}</ref>

Its US headquarters was in Pleasanton, California <ref name="AboutZoho" /> until it was moved to Del Valle, Texas, in 2019.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Egan |first=John |date=2021-12-17 |title=Austin-based tech company plugs into booming suburb with more than 100 jobs |url=https://austin.culturemap.com/news/innovation/12-17-21-tech-company-zoho-corp-office-austin-suburb-new-braunfels-100-jobs-bastrop/ |access-date=2022-01-11 |website=CultureMap Austin |language=en}}</ref> The [[research and development]] campus is in Estancia IT Park, Chennai. Zoho opened an office in [[Tenkasi]] in 2011, where its product Zoho Desk was built.<ref name="Inc">{{cite news|url=https://inc42.com/buzz/zoho-zohodesk-tenkasi/|title=How Zoho Aims To Put Tenkasi On The Map With Zoho Desk-A Product Built In The Downtown Of Nowhere|date=22 November 2016|newspaper=Inc42|access-date=27 February 2018|archive-date=28 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180228041515/https://inc42.com/buzz/zoho-zohodesk-tenkasi/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-07-12 |title=Zoho plans to set up offices in 100 rural districts to tap into local talent |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/zoho-plans-to-set-up-offices-in-100-rural-districts-to-tap-into-local-talent/articleshow/92830573.cms |access-date=2022-07-12}}</ref>  Since 2018, Zoho also operates from an office in [[Renigunta]], [[Andhra Pradesh]].<ref name="BL">{{cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/zoho-corporation-opens-office-at-renigunta/article10031688.ece|title=Zoho Corporation opens office at Renigunta|date=13 January 2018|newspaper=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=27 February 2018|archive-date=9 November 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191109122434/https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/zoho-corporation-opens-office-at-renigunta/article10031688.ece|url-status=live}}</ref>

In February 2022, Zoho opened an office in [[New Braunfels, Texas]], United States.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Knight|first=Steve |title=Global tech company establishes office in Saengerhalle in New Braunfels|url=https://herald-zeitung.com/community_alert/article_b54f019c-83af-11ec-bf33-2bebd0d87e5e.html|access-date=2022-02-22|website=Herald-Zeitung Online|date=February 2022 |language=en}}</ref> In April 2022, Zoho opened an office in [[McAllen, Texas]], in the [[Lower Rio Grande Valley|Rio Grande Valley]], the company's third location in Texas.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martinez |first=Patricia |date=2022-04-24 |title=McAllen lands Zoho |url=https://riograndeguardian.com/mcallen-lands-zoho/ |access-date=2022-08-16 |website=Rio Grande Guardian |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Taylor |first=Steve |date=2021-12-27 |title=Patridge: McAllen EDC will soon be welcoming a microchip manufacturer to the RGV |url=https://riograndeguardian.com/patridge-mcallen-edc-will-soon-be-welcoming-a-microchip-manufacturer-to-the-rgv/ |access-date=2022-08-16 |website=Rio Grande Guardian |language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2023, Zoho opened Zoho Labs R&D divisions in [[Nagpur]], India, for developing [[data center]] hardware.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Srinivas V |first=Vijay |date=12 Mar 2023 |title=India's SaaS industry bets on rural talent for further scale-up |url=https://www.livemint.com/technology/indias-saas-industry-bets-on-rural-talent-for-further-scaleup-11678616396791.html |access-date=13 August 2024 |website=livemint}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 December 2023 |title=PwC India, CWAS launch framework for ESG assessment of Indian cities |url=https://www.business-standard.com/economy/news/pwc-india-cwas-launch-framework-for-esg-assessment-of-indian-cities-123120300745_1.html |access-date=13 August 2023 |website=Business Standard}}</ref> As of 2025, Zoho operates data centers in 18 global locations, including Mumbai, Delhi, and Chennai in India.<ref name="dcn"/>
